items.name: MemoizeFormat
items.summary: Utility trait that allows memorizing the output of a [`Format`]. Useful to avoid re-formatting the same object twice.

methods.name: memoized
methods.signature: fn memoized(self) -> Memoized<Self, Context> where Self: Sized + Format<Context>
methods.summary: Returns a formattable object that memoizes the result of `Format` by cloning. Mainly useful if the same sub-tree can appear twice in the formatted output because it's used inside of `if_group_breaks` or `if_group_fits_single_line`.
